answer.worked:
A 5-mm lead plate can stop both α and β radiations and absorb a little γ radiation. We cannot tell whether the significant decrease in count rate is due to the absorption of β radiation when 5-mm lead plate is used as the absorber. 
∴ (1) is not necessarily correct.
When the 15-mm lead block replaces the 5-mm lead plate, the count rate shows further significant drop. This must be due to the absorption of γ radiation.
∴ (2) must be correct.
The 15-mm lead block does not stop γ radiation. Therefore, the background count rate should be lower than 157 counts per minute.
∴ (3) is incorrect.

answer.worked:

∴ (2) is incorrect.
